description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing mention keywords and IDs for users and groups within the Mattermost server, including adding users, groups, and handling mention-related logic.

classes.name: MentionableID
classes.description: Type alias for string representing a mentionable user or group ID.

methods.name: mentionableUserID
methods.description: Creates a MentionableID for a user based on user ID.

methods.name: mentionableGroupID
methods.description: Creates a MentionableID for a group based on group ID.

methods.name: AsUserID
methods.description: Extracts user ID from MentionableID if it has user prefix.

methods.name: AsGroupID
methods.description: Extracts group ID from MentionableID if it has group prefix.

methods.name: AddUser
methods.description: Adds a user and related mention keys to the MentionKeywords collection.

methods.name: AddUserKeyword
methods.description: Adds a specific keyword for a user ID to the MentionKeywords collection.

methods.name: AddGroup
methods.description: Adds a group mention to the MentionKeywords collection.

methods.name: AddGroupsMap
methods.description: Adds multiple groups to the MentionKeywords collection.
